title: B2 · L20 — Linkers of cause & effect
description: Conectores de causa-efecto: as a result, consequently, thereby, owing to, due to. Registro formal y académico.

questions.prompt: Situación: redactas la sección 'Findings' de un informe financiero.
questions.question: Complete: 'Sales dropped sharply. ___, several stores had to close.'
questions.explanation: 'As a result' expresa consecuencia directa entre dos oraciones — es sinónimo natural de 'consequently', 'therefore', 'thus'. Los demás conectores tienen funciones distintas: 'nevertheless' es contraste, 'in spite of' también, 'namely' especifica. Elegir el conector correcto es lo que estructura un argumento coherente.
examples: It rained heavily throughout the day. As a result, the game was postponed until Sunday. → nota deportiva
She studied hard for months. As a result, she passed with distinction. → perfil académico

questions.prompt: Redactas un comunicado de una aerolínea.
questions.question: Choose the correct construction with 'due to':
options: The flight was cancelled due to bad weather.
Due to bad weather occurred, the flight was cancelled.
Due to it rained, the flight was cancelled.
questions.explanation: 'Due to + sustantivo o -ing'. NUNCA se combina con cláusula completa (sujeto + verbo). La estructura es idéntica a 'because of', sólo cambia el registro (más formal). Confundir 'due to' con 'because' es el error frecuente al escribir emails corporativos.
examples: The 30-minute delay was due to technical issues with the boarding system. → aviso oficial
Due to poor visibility over the Channel, the ferry service has been suspended.

questions.statement: 'Because' introduce causa con cláusula completa, mientras que 'because of' lleva sustantivo.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Es la regla básica pero mal aprendida: 'because + sujeto + verbo' vs 'because of + sustantivo/-ing'. En español ambos se traducen como 'porque/por', lo que explica la confusión. Regla mnemotécnica: si tras el conector hay UN sustantivo solo, añade 'of'; si hay ORACIÓN, no.
examples: Because it was raining heavily, we stayed in with a film and popcorn. → causa con cláusula
Because of the rain, we stayed in with a film and popcorn. → causa con sustantivo

questions.text: The project failed owing to poor communication between the different departments involved.
questions.explanation: 'Owing to + sustantivo' es sinónimo formal de 'because of', muy frecuente en escritura profesional para explicar causas de resultados negativos. Prosodia formal, énfasis en 'poor communication'. Connected speech: 'owing to' se enlaza suave 'oʊɪŋ-tə'. 'The different departments involved' es participio reducido.
examples: The company collapsed owing to years of mismanagement and unchecked expansion. → crónica económica
Flights across the region were cancelled owing to unusually dense fog. → aviso aeroportuario

questions.prompt: Redactas la cláusula justificativa de un contrato.
questions.question: Which is the most formal way to express cause?
questions.explanation: 'Owing to the fact that + cláusula' es la forma más formal y elaborada. Frecuente en informes oficiales, textos legales, comunicados corporativos y trabajos académicos. En hablado suena rígido; en escritura formal aporta un tono muy profesional. Es la 'muleta' para combinar 'owing to' con una cláusula completa.
examples: The meeting was cancelled owing to the fact that key participants were unable to attend.
The policy was revised owing to the fact that it caused significant confusion among staff.

questions.statement: 'Thereby' introduce una consecuencia lograda mediante una acción.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Thereby + -ing' expresa el efecto DIRECTO obtenido gracias a la acción anterior. Muy formal, típico de textos científicos, técnicos y jurídicos. Menos común en escritura periodística; casi nunca en hablado. Aporta un aire elevado y preciso al análisis causal.
examples: The system was upgraded, thereby improving efficiency by nearly 40%. → informe técnico
She publicly apologised, thereby effectively ending the media conflict. → crónica política

questions.prompt: Empareja cada conector con su cláusula correspondiente:

pairs.left: As a result of the strike,

questions.explanation: Reglas visibles: 'because/since/as' + cláusula completa; 'due to/as a result of' + sustantivo o -ing; 'consequently' es adverbio conectivo entre oraciones independientes. Elegir bien depende de qué viene después: cláusula o sintagma nominal.
examples: Since you're clearly the expert here, please walk us through the details. → reunión colaborativa
As a result of the recent budget cuts, staff had to be reduced by 15%. → nota de HR

questions.prompt: Justificas un retraso en un email al equipo.
questions.question: Complete: 'The report will be delayed ___ several team members being ill.'
questions.explanation: 'Several team members being ill' es una construcción con -ing (nominalización), NO una cláusula. Por eso necesita 'due to'. 'Because', 'since' o 'as' exigirían cláusula completa: 'because several team members are ill'. La detección de si lo que sigue es nombre/-ing o cláusula es clave.
examples: The event was cancelled due to lack of interest from the attendees. → nota organizativa
Energy prices have risen sharply due to increased global demand and supply chain issues.

questions.target: The company invested heavily in new technology and, as a result, saw a significant increase in productivity.
questions.explanation: Estructura de causa-efecto con 'as a result' entre comas — muy típica de presentaciones de resultados empresariales y earnings calls. Prosodia: ritmo confidente, énfasis en 'significant increase'. Nativos añaden datos concretos: '15% year-on-year', 'across all divisions' para aportar credibilidad al resultado.
examples: We restructured the customer service team and, as a result, saw morale improve dramatically.
Investment in R&D increased by 40% and, as a result, three new patents were filed this year.

questions.prompt: Cierras un párrafo académico con una conclusión lógica.
questions.question: Which linker expresses REASON in a formal explanation?
questions.explanation: 'Hence' significa 'por lo tanto, de ahí que' — marca una conclusión lógica derivada de lo anterior. Es muy formal, casi académico/filosófico. Sinónimos: 'therefore', 'thus'. Los otros conectores tienen otras funciones: 'yet' (contraste), 'moreover' (adición), 'however' (contraste).
examples: The data was inconclusive. Hence, further research is genuinely needed. → paper académico
He was clearly ill; hence his absence from the board meeting. → nota interna

questions.statement: 'Since' se puede usar para expresar tanto tiempo como razón.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Since + fecha/momento + present perfect' = tiempo (desde ese momento). 'Since + cláusula' = razón (porque). El contexto y la construcción gramatical aclaran el significado. Este doble uso confunde a hispanohablantes que traducen 'since' automáticamente como 'desde'.
examples: Time: I've lived in Lisbon since 2018 — best decision I ever made. → fecha + present perfect
Reason: Since you're free tomorrow, could you help me move some boxes? → cláusula, razón

questions.text: The team worked overtime for weeks, and thereby completed the project ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: 'Thereby + -ing' expresa consecuencia lograda mediante la acción, en registro formal escrito. Va precedido de coma o punto y coma. Prosodia: pausa clara antes de 'thereby'. Connected speech: 'thereby completed' se enlaza 'ðeəbaɪ-kəmpliːtɪd'. 'Ahead of schedule' es colocación fija que suena profesional.
examples: He invested wisely in index funds, thereby securing a comfortable retirement. → historia financiera
They negotiated firmly but fairly, thereby getting a much better deal than expected.

questions.prompt: Identifica el uso correcto de 'because of'.
questions.question: Which sentence uses 'because of' correctly?
options: Because of it was late, we left.
Because of the late hour, we left.
Because of we were late, we left.
Because of that late, we left.
questions.explanation: 'Because of + sustantivo o sintagma nominal' — nada más. La opción A y C intentan meter cláusulas completas (error), y la D pone un adverbio agramatical. Sólo 'the late hour' es un sintagma nominal correcto. Regla clave para hispanohablantes: 'because of' NO acepta oración.
examples: Because of the weather, the match was cancelled last minute. → nota deportiva
Because of her tireless efforts, the entire project came together on time. → agradecimiento

questions.target: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the conference has been postponed until further notice.
questions.explanation: 'Due to unforeseen circumstances' es una fórmula fija muy usada en comunicaciones oficiales cuando no queremos o no podemos especificar la causa real. 'Until further notice' es otra colocación fija (sin plazo definido). Prosodia: tono profesional y neutral, sin cargas emocionales. Registro de aviso corporativo, cine, aeropuerto, museo.
examples: Due to technical issues, the entire website is currently offline. We're working on it.
Due to overwhelming demand, seats for the workshop are now extremely limited.

questions.prompt: Buscas el conector que expresa causa con cláusula, no con nombre.
questions.question: Which expresses cause with a full clause?
questions.explanation: 'As + cláusula' significa 'porque' — es una alternativa formal a 'because', muy común al inicio de oración en registro medio-formal (escritura periodística, cartas educadas). Los otros tres ('due to', 'because of', 'owing to') SIEMPRE van con sustantivo o -ing, nunca con cláusula.
examples: As it was already late, we decided to call it a night. → registro reflexivo
As she was completely swamped with work, she couldn't join us for dinner.
